test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Mohiniyattam belongs to which of the following states?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **Kerala.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam**

 
 
• ​It is literally interpreted as the dance of** ‘Mohini’.**
 
• It is one of the two classical dance forms that originated in **Kerala, **the other one being Kathakali.
 
• It is based on **Natya Shastra’s lasya style.**
 
• It has delicate movements and more feminine **facial expressions.**
 
• The repertoire of Mohiniyattam includes music in the Carnatic style, singing and acting a play through the dance, where the recitation may be either by a separate vocalist or the dancer themselves.
 
• **More emphasis is on the facial expressions and hand gestures.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0429174e644a55ef0c3acd1da66a226143258ecc3ba21c6280e0c038a6e75eb6.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eight Classical dances** recognised by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi and the Ministry of Culture**

 
 
• **Bharatanatyam, from Tamil Nadu**
 
• **Kathak, from Uttar Pradesh**
 
• **Kathakali, from Kerala**
 
• **Kuchipudi, from Andhra Pradesh**
 
• **Manipuri, from Manipur**
 
• **Mohiniyattam, from Kerala**
 
• **Odissi, from Odisha**
 
• **Sattriya, from Assam**
 
 

Additionally, the Indian Ministry of Culture includes Chhau, from Eastern India (Odisha, Jharkhand, and West Bengal) in its list, recognizing nine total styles.
